title: BalancePet changelog notices v1
description: Changes published outside a release. Every file-type change uploaded to GitHub gets an entry here: a specification gaining a section, a document being corrected, published content being rewritten. Titles stay within twelve characters because the speech bubble shows one. An entry never announces a new version -- a specification gaining a section, a document being corrected, published content being rewritten. An entry never announces a new version -- that is the update check's job.

seq.description: Positive, unique, and strictly increasing with time. This is the watermark: a reader records the highest number it has shown, and everything above it is new.

date.description: For display only; nothing is compared against it, because a comparison at day resolution would let two notices published the same day hide each other.

area.description: Short category shown beside the date, such as 规范, 文档 or 在线内容.

title.description: Kept to twelve characters because this is the line the pet's speech bubble shows, next to a count and a pointer to the changelog window. A longer title pushes that pointer out. The summary is where the explanation goes.

summary.description: Where "what changed" is answered. A title alone rarely does.

url.description: Absolute https address to the change itself. Opened by the shell, so anything else is refused when the document is parsed.
